xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: 1 The audited Consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2024 were reviewed by the Audit Committee meeting and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 18, 2024 and are available on the parent Company’s website - www.jains.com. 2 The statutory Auditors - M/s Singhi & Co., Chartered Accountants, have carried out statutory audit of the results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2024. 3 During the year ended March 31, 2024, the Company received Rs.4,989 lacs as 25% money against the subscription of 42,786,430 Equity Share Warrants to be converted into Equity Shares upon payment of balance 75% by May 2025. During the year ended March 31, 2024, the Parent company received the balance 75% of allotment money amounting to Rs.13,603 lacs (Nil for the quarter ended March 31, 2024) from the warrant holders against the allotment of 62,822,877 Ordinary Equity Shares (Nil for the quarter ended March 31, 2024) on conversion of the Equity Share Warrants. 4 Finance cost includes non-cash transaction being unwinding of 0.01% NCDs/ECBs as per effective interest rate of Rs. 1,674 lacs, Rs.1,646 lacs and Rs.6,476 lacs for the quarter ended March 31, 2024, quarter ended December 31, 2023 and year ended March 31, 2024 respectively. The corresponding figure for the quarter ended March 31, 2023 and year ended March 31, 2023 is Rs.1,734 lacs and Rs.6,944 lacs respectively. Further, Finance cost for the year ended March 31,2023 Includes loss on modification of non-convertible debentures (NCD) of Rs.4,421 lacs resulting from change in amount and timing of expected cash flow payments on NCD and for other reporting periods the amount is Nil. 5 Exceptional Items includes various expenses in relation to Resolution Plan incurred by the company of Rs.1,479 lacs during the year ended March 31, 2023 and Rs.687 lacs for the quarter ended Mar 31, 2023. 6 Other income includes foreign exchange gain and derivatives gain of Rs.(825) lacs, Rs.620 lacs and Rs.5 lacs for the quarter ended Mar-24, quarter ended Dec-23 and for the year ended Mar-24 respectively. The corresponding amount of foreign exchange gain and derivatives gain for the quarter ended Mar-23 and year ended Mar-23 are Rs.(1,092) lacs and Rs.5,153 lacs respectively. 7 On March 29, 2023, Jain International Trading B.V., Netherlands (JITBV) a wholly-owned subsidiary of parent Company and Rivulis completed the transaction contemplated therein. All the regulatory approvals related to the merger of multiple overseas subsidiaries of JITBV have been received by both entities. The condition precedent required by Share Purchase Agreement entered into by Rivulis Pte. Ltd & Jain International Trading B.V, have been satisfied. Jain (Israel) B.V. (step down subsidiary of JITBV) is holding a minority stake of ~18.7% in Rivulis Pte. Ltd post-merger. A proportion of the transaction proceeds is utilised for repayment debt of International Irrigation Business (IIB) and JITBV along with other liability/ies leading to significant reduction in debt at consolidated level. Completion of Accounts as envisaged under the Transaction documents has been concluded during the current quarter and the resultant impact of Rs. 4,821 lacs has been recognised as loss related to sale of discontinued operation. 8 The figures of the last quarter are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of full financial year up to March 31, 2024/ March 31, 2023 and the unaudited published year-to- date figures up to December 31, 2023 / December 31, 2022 being the figures up to the end of the third quarter of financial year respectively which were subject to limited review. 9 The previous year/period figures have been regrouped, rearranged, reclassified or reworked as necessary to confirm the current quarter/year classification.
